name: Haunter
prompt: Create a new transparent pixel-art game atlas matching the EXACT character, form and regional colours of the reference. SIXTEEN complete sprites in FOUR columns FOUR rows with broad transparent gaps. Camera rows SOUTHfront/EASTright/NORTHback(no face)/WESTleft. First two columns are expressive wince and braced bend with head low/eyes closed. Last two columns show body lowering and fully flat on ground, head resting and limbs folded; final column stays resting. Preserve distinctive anatomy, tail, ears, wings, accessories and markings. Each view stays fixed through both sequences; back never turns to face the camera. New anatomical poses with crisp original pixel clusters and consistent scale, no rotated/scaled standing copies. No text, effects, extra marks or scenery.

review.scope: Independent visual review, normal and shiny separately; exact PNG hashes checked
